objective: Proof: for any set of allowed states, c lies between a and b in the differ count (d(a,b) = d(a,c) + d(c,b)) iff no state has a = b != c; a not-all-equal knot abc holds iff the three differ counts sum to twice the number of states; hence the differ table determines every nonempty not-all-equal relation on n >= 4 distinctions, fails at n = 3 (one knot against none), and no pairwise count sees a parity knot. Exhaustive code check at n <= 6.
title: A knot is a betweenness: the differ count determines every not-all-equal base
